statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is low after the post-payroll session produced substantial retracement and mixed breadth rather than a persistent one-way Nasdaq path.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; residual risk is concentrated in the nearly complete late-session window and in weekend headline/gap exposure, while Stress remains extreme.
headline: Tail falls to low as post-payroll path remains two-sided
body: Strong August payrolls lifted Treasury yields and rate-hike expectations, but late-session cash evidence showed semiconductor outperformance and nearly balanced Nasdaq breadth. Available NQ session data also shows a broad intraday range with recovery from the low. Tail is low, while elevated rates and U.S.-Iran/Hormuz risk keep Stress extreme.

lookbackSummary: Tail peaked at 29% in the September 3 20:00 UTC slot, fell into the low/watch bands overnight, stayed at WATCH into the payroll release, briefly rose to 28% on a delayed downside leg at 16:00 UTC, and then returned to WATCH as two-sided structure reappeared.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours are predominantly a weekend closed-market interval. Tail is forecast to remain low unless later tradable price discovery confirms persistent extension; Stress stays extreme because the stronger labor data, elevated yields and Middle East energy risk can still affect reopening gaps.

forecast.analysis: Late-session evidence is mixed: indexes were lower, semiconductors outperformed and Nasdaq breadth was nearly balanced. Available NQ session data shows recovery from the low, keeping Tail low while rates and geopolitics keep Stress extreme.
